sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
Head Ball Hyper Casual Game's core gameplay mechanics revolve around the player's head. Using mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, players can move their head, kick the ball, and control the ball's trajectory. The game requires a combination of speed, agility, and strategy to succeed. Players must carefully time their kicks, use the right amount of force, and control the ball's momentum to score goals.

One of the key features of Head Ball is its emphasis on skill-based gameplay. Players can upgrade their skills, such as speed, agility, and kick power, to improve their performance in the game. The game also features a variety of power-ups and special abilities that can be used to gain an edge over opponents.

Head Ball's gameplay is divided into short matches, each lasting around 3-5 minutes. Players can play against the CPU or other players online. The game's matchmaking system ensures that players are matched with opponents of similar skill levels, making it a challenging but fair experience.

Head Ball's core gameplay mechanics are designed to provide an immersive experience that will keep players engaged and challenged. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a casual player, the game's emphasis on skill-based gameplay and strategic thinking will keep you coming back for more.
